description_en: View the Performance Monitoring of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance over a specified time period.
description_zh: 查看AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例在指定时间段的性能监控
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-db-cluster-performance --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --key adbpg_conn_count --start-time 2021-11-03T15:00Z --end-time 2021-11-03T15:10Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterPerformance

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query details about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The performance metric that you want to query. Separate multiple values with commas (,). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86943.html
parameters.help_zh: 性能参数名称，多个指标用英文半角（,）分隔，具体信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86943.html
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ` format.

You can query monitoring information only within the last 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ`。

仅支持查询30天内的监控信息
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ` format.

The end time must be later than the start time. The maximum time range that can be specified is seven days
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ`。

查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，且开始时间和结束时间的时间间隔不能超过7天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The nodes for which you want to query performance metrics. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Example: `master-10******1,master-10******2`. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/390136.html operation to query the names of nodes.

You can also filter the nodes based on their metric values. Valid values:

top10: the 10 nodes that have the highest metric values.
top20: the 20 nodes that have the highest metric values.
bottom10: the 10 nodes that have the lowest metric values.
bottom20: the 20 nodes that have the lowest metric values
parameters.help_zh:
用于查询一个或多个节点的监控指标，多个节点名称间使用英文逗号（,）分隔，例如`master-10******1,master-10******2`。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/390136.html接口获取节点名称。


您也可以根据监控指标的高低筛选节点，取值说明：
top10：监控指标最高的十个节点。
top20：监控指标最高的二十个节点。
bottom10：监控指标最低的十个节点。
bottom20：监控指标最低的二十个节点
parameters.name: nodes

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:

master: coordinator node.
segment: compute node.

If you do not specify this parameter, the performance metrics of all nodes are returned
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型。取值说明：

master：Master节点。
segment：Segment节点。

如果不传入该参数，则返回所有节点的监控指标
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_name

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 查询结束时间（UTC时间），格式为`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ`

PerformanceKeys.description_en: The name of the performance metric. For more information, see [Performance parameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86943.html）

Name.description_en: The name of the performance metric. For more information, see [Performance parameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86943.html）
Name.description_zh: 性能参数名称，具体信息，请参见[性能参数表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86943.html）

Series.description_en: Details of the performance metric of a node

Name.description_en: The name of the compute node or compute group
Name.description_zh: 计算节点或计算组名称

Role.description_en:
The role of the node. Valid values:

master: primary coordinator node
standby: standby coordinator node
segment: compute node
Role.description_zh:
节点的角色，取值说明：

master：主节点。
standby：备节点。
segment：计算节点

Values.description_en: The value of the performance metric collected at a point in time
Values.description_zh: 性能参数值，每个值对应一个采集时间点

Point.description_en: The value of the performance metric and the time when the metric value was collected

items.description_en: Specific Performance Monitoring information, consisting of time and performance parameter value.
items.description_zh: 性能监控具体信息，由时间和性能参数值构成

Unit.description_en: The unit of the performance metric

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 查询开始时间（UTC时间），格式为`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ`
